strings.zh: 正確用法：洗臉後皮膚乾燥（等 5-10 分鐘）再薄塗於整臉，避開眼周、鼻翼凹陷處。先擦保濕再 A 酸可降低刺激（buffer 法）。白天必須擦 SPF 30+ 廣譜防曬。
strings.en: Correct technique: wait until the face is dry after cleansing (5–10 min), then apply a thin layer over the whole face, avoiding the periocular area and nasolabial folds. Applying moisturizer first (the “buffer” method) reduces irritation. SPF 30+ broad-spectrum sunscreen is mandatory during the day.

strings.zh: 選對強度與部位是關鍵：
strings.en: Picking the right potency for the right body site is key:

strings.zh: 不要把外用抗生素當「萬用藥」長擦 — 容易產生抗藥性。一般傷口或濕疹擦凡士林就好，有膿、紅、熱、痛才用抗生素。
strings.en: Don't use topical antibiotics as a “cure-all” for prolonged periods — antibiotic resistance develops easily. For ordinary wounds or eczema, plain petrolatum is sufficient; antibiotics are only needed when there's pus, erythema, warmth, and pain.

strings.zh: 3 個月療程後若仍嚴重，應升級到口服 A 酸。
strings.en: If still severe after a 3-month course, escalate to oral isotretinoin.

strings.zh: 都是非類固醇外用藥，主要用於異位性皮膚炎：
strings.en: All non-steroidal topicals primarily used for atopic dermatitis:

strings.zh: 每層之間等 1-2 分鐘吸收再擦下一層。新增成分一次只加 1 個，觀察 2 週確認沒問題再加下一個。
strings.en: Wait 1–2 minutes between layers for each to absorb. Add only one new active at a time, observing for 2 weeks before introducing the next.

strings.zh: 白天用維他命 C(L-ascorbic acid 10-20%)，晚上用 A 酸（Tretinoin 或 A 醇）。原理：
strings.en: Vitamin C (L-ascorbic acid 10–20%) in the morning, retinoid (tretinoin or retinol) at night. Rationale:

strings.zh: 過度卸妝（每天用強效卸妝水大力搓）會破壞皮膚屏障，反而引起敏感。原則：該卸就卸，不需要過度。
strings.en: Over-cleansing (vigorously scrubbing with strong makeup remover daily) damages the barrier and triggers sensitivity. Principle: remove makeup when needed, but don't over-do it.

strings.zh: 看到痘痘消了之後仍有凹陷 — 越早處理越輕鬆。
strings.en: If you see indentation remaining after pimples resolve — the earlier you treat, the easier the management.

strings.zh: 常見副作用：嘴唇乾(>90%)、皮膚乾、夜盲、肌肉痛、情緒變化。
strings.en: Common adverse effects: dry lips (>90%), dry skin, night vision changes, myalgia, mood changes.

strings.zh: 沒有實證需禁的：巧克力、油炸、辣椒、海鮮、堅果、豆漿、雞蛋。建議減糖減奶 3 個月觀察。
strings.en: No evidence requiring avoidance: chocolate, fried foods, chili, seafood, nuts, soy milk, eggs. A 3-month trial of reduced sugar and dairy is reasonable.

strings.zh: 選擇看目標：斑點 → 皮秒；肌膚整體 → 蜂巢皮秒；深凹疤 → 飛梭 CO2。
strings.en: Choose by target: pigmentation → picosecond; overall skin quality → fractional pico (Pico Genesis); deep atrophic scars → fractional CO₂.

strings.zh: 單純雷射沒搭配藥膏 + 防曬 = 浪費錢且易反黑。
strings.en: Laser alone without topical therapy + sun protection = wasted money and high risk of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation.

strings.zh: 避免侵入性 / 高熱雷射：
飛梭 / 高能量雷射 / 換膚：
「不敢擦類固醇」是異膚兒童惡化最大原因。每天保濕 + 急性期積極治療 + 緩解期 proactive 維持 = 控制良好。
strings.en: “Steroid phobia” is the single largest reason pediatric AD worsens. Daily moisturizer + aggressive flare treatment + proactive maintenance = good control.

strings.zh: 分不清就帶寶寶看皮膚科，對症下藥才對。
strings.en: If you can't distinguish, see a dermatologist — treatment should match the diagnosis.

strings.zh: 建議：計畫懷孕前完成接種，或產後 / 哺乳結束後再接種（Shingrix 哺乳母親可考慮但需與醫師討論）。
strings.en: Recommendation: complete vaccination before planned pregnancy, or after delivery/lactation. Shingrix may be considered in lactating mothers but should be discussed with the physician.

strings.zh: 沒找到你的問題？以下是針對特定主題的完整衛教文章：
strings.en: Didn't find your question? Here are full articles on specific topics:

strings.zh: 膿痂疹(impetigo)、毛囊炎、傷口感染、抓破的濕疹合併感染
strings.en: Impetigo, folliculitis, wound infection, secondarily infected eczema

strings.zh: 術後傷口、雷射後 2-3 天
實用判斷：洗完皮膚摸起來還有「卡卡」、殘留感，就需卸妝
strings.en: Practical test: if skin feels “coated” or residual after cleansing, makeup remover is needed

strings.zh: A 酸 + 高濃度果酸 / 水楊酸 = 過度刺激，屏障壞掉
strings.en: Retinoid + high-concentration AHA/BHA = overstimulation, barrier damage

strings.zh: A 酸 + 高濃度 BPO = BPO 會氧化分解 A 酸
strings.en: Retinoid + high-concentration BPO = BPO oxidatively degrades the retinoid

strings.zh: A 酸 + 維他命 C = 同晚刺激倍增
strings.en: Retinoid + vitamin C in the same evening = irritation doubled
Use the “Vitamin C in the morning, retinoid at night” split

strings.zh: A 酸隔天輪用（中間夜晚改杜鵑花酸或菸鹼醯胺）
strings.en: Apply retinoid every other night (alternating with azelaic acid or niacinamide)

strings.zh: 果酸 / 水楊酸建議白天用低濃度，或單獨用一晚
strings.en: Use AHA/BHA at low concentration during the day, or on a separate night

strings.zh: 劑量 0.5-1 mg/kg/day，療程 6-9 個月，目標累積劑量 120-150 mg/kg
strings.en: Dosing 0.5–1 mg/kg/day for 6–9 months; target cumulative dose 120–150 mg/kg
Pre-treatment labs: AST/ALT, triglycerides, cholesterol, β-hCG (women)

strings.zh: 每月回診 + 追蹤抽血（第 1、2、4、6 個月）
strings.en: Monthly follow-up + repeat labs at months 1, 2, 4, and 6

strings.zh: 女性育齡需嚴格避孕（致畸胎），療程前 1 個月 + 整個療程 + 結束後 1 個月
strings.en: Women of childbearing age require strict contraception (teratogenic): 1 month before + entire course + 1 month after

strings.zh: 荷爾蒙波動（月經前、停服避孕藥、PCOS、停經前期）
strings.en: Hormonal fluctuations (premenstrual, oral contraceptive discontinuation, PCOS, perimenopause)

strings.zh: 壓力（會增加皮質醇 → 刺激皮脂腺）
保養品 / 防曬選錯（致粉刺成分）
類固醇藥物、男性化藥物
三合一藥膏 / Hydroquinone 4%（處方,8-12 週）
口服傳明酸 250 mg BID-TID（8-12 週）
strings.en: Oral tranexamic acid 250 mg BID–TID (8–12 weeks)

strings.zh: 當天：不化妝、避免熱水洗臉、避免運動流汗
strings.en: Same day: no makeup, avoid hot water washing, avoid exercise/sweating

strings.zh: 第 2-3 天：可化淡妝；繼續加強保濕
strings.en: Days 2–3: light makeup OK; continue intensive moisturization

strings.zh: 保濕 + 修護（維他命 B5、Centella）幫助恢復
strings.en: Moisturizer + barrier repair (vitamin B5, Centella) speeds recovery

strings.zh: 使用醫師建議的修護敷料 / 凡士林
外用低中強效類固醇短期(Hydrocortisone、Mometasone)
外用 Calcineurin inhibitor(Tacrolimus、Pimecrolimus)— 哺乳避免在乳頭使用
strings.en: Topical calcineurin inhibitors (tacrolimus, pimecrolimus) — avoid nipple use during lactation
Niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, vitamin C, Centella
Pure physical sunscreens (zinc oxide, titanium dioxide)

strings.zh: 口服 A 酸 Isotretinoin（致畸胎）
口服抗黴菌（Itraconazole 致畸胎）
急性期每天 1-2 次連用 7-14 天
緩解後改週末療法（週六、日各 1 次）
strings.en: After remission: weekend therapy (Saturday + Sunday once each)

strings.zh: 避開大面積、長期、高強度
strings.en: Avoid large surface area, long duration, and high potency

strings.zh: 臺灣皮膚科醫學會(TDA)各疾病臨床診療共識：痤瘡(2024)、異位性皮膚炎(2020)、玫瑰斑(2022)、乾癬(2024)、圓禿(2024)、蕁麻疹(2021)、白斑(2024)、化膿性汗腺炎、帶狀疱疹疫苗接種建議(2022)、猴痘皮膚照護指引、TKI 標靶藥物皮膚毒性(2024)。
strings.en: Taiwanese Dermatological Association (TDA) consensus statements: acne (2024), atopic dermatitis (2020), rosacea (2022), psoriasis (2024), alopecia areata (2024), urticaria (2021), vitiligo (2024), hidradenitis suppurativa, herpes zoster vaccination (2022), mpox skin care guidelines, TKI dermatologic toxicity (2024).

strings.zh: UV 會分解 A 酸
A 酸讓皮膚對 UV 敏感

strings.en: Skin repair activity is highest at night

strings.zh: 長期、大面積、強效類固醇用錯部位
strings.en: Long-term, large-area, high-potency steroids applied to the wrong site

strings.zh: 真正細菌感染或感染風險高
strings.en: True bacterial infection or high infection risk

strings.zh: 物理性防曬、含氧化鐵、有色防曬、防水抗汗款
strings.en: Physical sunscreens, iron-oxide-containing, tinted, water-resistant formulations

strings.zh: 洗澡 / 洗臉後 3 分鐘內
strings.en: Within 3 minutes of bathing or face washing
Not recommended to layer on the same night

strings.zh: 痘印 PIH（色素沉著）/ PIE（紅疤）
strings.en: Post-acne marks: PIH (post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation) / PIE (post-inflammatory erythema)

strings.zh: 不會自己好，擦藥也無效
strings.en: Doesn't resolve on its own, and topicals are ineffective
Severe hepatic injury is extremely rare

strings.zh: 傳統 Q 開關雷射
低能量皮秒 toning（蜂巢皮秒 1064 nm 低能量）
strings.en: Low-energy pico-toning (fractional pico 1064 nm low fluence)
If diagnosis is uncertain, start with NHI consultation

strings.zh: 杜鵑花酸 Azelaic acid + 純物理防曬（含氧化鐵）
strings.en: Azelaic acid + pure physical sunscreen (iron oxide)

strings.zh: 類固醇藥膏是嬰幼兒異膚第一線治療
strings.en: Topical corticosteroids are first-line for infant/childhood AD
